flagged.evidence: The proof concludes: “Hence exactly four of the eight interval partitions satisfy the criterion, and by [F3] these are exactly the lattice congruences of D.” But [F3] applies to equivalence relations whose classes are intervals; it does not establish that every congruence has interval classes. The dependency lem-cg-lattice-quotient-descent-and-class-intervals, Statement (ii), supplies that fact (“the class is the interval between them”), but Proof 2.2 does not invoke it to exclude congruences outside the eight enumerated partitions. The claim is true once that clause is applied; this is a readily closed proof gap.
